articles.title: 4 new governors named, picks underline BJP focus on elections
articles.summary: India has appointed four new governors, a move interpreted by political observers as strategically underlining the ruling BJP's focus on upcoming elections. These appointments are significant as governors hold vital constitutional positions in state administration, influencing central-state relations. SSB aspirants should track such national political developments and understand their broader implications for governance.

articles.title: Promoting Christianity does not amount to outraging religious feelings: Bombay HC
articles.summary: A concerning report indicates a growing number of Maharashtra's talukas are experiencing critical issues with shrinking groundwater levels and depleted soil moisture. This trend highlights increasing environmental stress and significant challenges for agricultural productivity and water security across the region. Such developments demand urgent attention for sustainable resource management and future planning.

articles.title: HORROR MOVIES THAT SHOCKED FANS AND WERE BETTER THAN ANYONE EXPECTED! - Entertainment
articles.summary: Some horror films often arrive with very low expectations, stemming from shaky franchises, silly premises, or first-time directors. However, these cinematic offerings frequently defy initial skepticism, proving far scarier and more impactful than anticipated. They successfully deliver intense frights, leaving a lasting impression on audiences despite their humble beginnings, showcasing how effective execution can overcome initial doubts.
